title: Apply both task-specific decision policies at exact thresholds

outcome: Explicit legal policies alter final decisions without changing raw decisions or probability populations.

artifacts.purpose: Effective policy and final-decision inspection alternatives

interfaces: RejectBelow uses confidence or working max_probability with finite minimum in [0,1].
LabelThresholds requires a complete vocabulary map; >= selects a label, below removes it without abstaining.
Both configured policies require every row answered and required scoring family; no observation promotion.
acceptance_criteria: Equality passes; immediately adjacent binary64 values behave exactly; all-below marginals produce answered empty set.
Submitted abstentions remain illegal for these policies even with complete signals; wrong task or missing signal yields typed error.
Raw losses/metrics stay unchanged; final evidence and rejection reason identify policy effects.

verification.expected: All below/equal/above cases and the scored-choice confidence-vs-max case match specification; raw confidence bins retain threshold-rejected answered rows and their IDs.

verification_responsibility: A different agent from the implementation author reruns evidence and reviews every acceptance criterion; integrator accepts only the saved response.
common_completion_checks: All listed artifacts contain implemented behavior or required evidence; no placeholders.

All tests assigned to this task are listed by Cargo and execute with a nonzero expected test count. Compound conformance/structure cases have explicit later audit test owners in coverage.json; implementers still test each local invariant now.
Relevant fmt/Clippy/test/build checks pass on the pinned toolchain; no bypass, changed tolerance or weakened oracle.
Saved response records exact input/source/output hashes, commands, exit codes, expected/actual results, and unresolved failures.
New or changed-authority artifacts are indexed; operational state is updated in Fizzy after acceptance.
